name: TC-BDM-02: lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Body Makers
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UtilityPages/BodyMakers.cy.js#UtilityPages - BodyMakers [en] — Body Makers TC-BDM-02: lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Body Makers
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BDM-02
**Title:** Lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Body Makers
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Body Makers page, open the lead form via "Talk To Dealer", and submit with every field left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile, location, brand and model are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Body Makers page
2. Click a dealer card's "Talk To Dealer" button to open its lead form
3. Leave every field empty and submit
4. Verify all five required-field validation messages are shown
